M.result64.native_rule: M op3; valid row; capture before overwriting merged

M.read32.native_rule: M op5 logical8/16/32 remain S32 carriers; sat retained

M.partial_diag.native_rule: M op12 valid/owner; diagnostic algorithm binding required

N.exp.native_rule: N op3, max32768; preserve group/max/code lineage

N.probability.native_rule: N op6, max16384; probability is not unnormalized EXP

N.topk_ids.native_rule: N op10; ID not score or source-record position

N.stats.native_rule: N op7; select field before numeric casting

N.factor.native_rule: N op11; formula and Norm/Softmax context required

E.cast32_to16.native_rule: E op13; upper64 padding, tail external

G.gated.native_rule: gated fn and gate units retained

R.output.native_rule: R op12 before commit/next EXEC clears output

R.active_state.native_rule: R op11 active_valid; pending reads OLD active

R.active_history.native_rule: R op14 history_valid; pending reads OLD history

R.meta.native_rule: R op13; does not expose all internal validity/failed flags

S.stored_word.native_rule: read response must match known initialization/writer schema

S.write_echo.native_rule: explicit ACK-forward only; capture echo and ACK before same-S reentry

S.loader_B.native_rule: n-major/half; split512; complete both A/B obligations

T.committed_word.native_rule: committed sequential index/last; tail separate; release after drain

M.scale.native_rule: op4 index0; zero upper43; compound fields from named sources/ROM

M.exec_descriptor.native_rule: op10 bank<<5; reserved bits zero; loaded bank/format/append context

N.epsilon.native_rule: BEGIN mode1/2 only; no active-group hijack

N.count.native_rule: per stage and remaining group count

G.fn.native_rule: finite approved function; tag changes output units

R.epoch.native_rule: matching context; commit cannot advance0xffffffff; no stale reuse

R.position.native_rule: family token/subversion rule and expected position

R.length.native_rule: OPEN no pending; state storage capacity

R.mode.native_rule: EXEC matching owner/epoch/position and mode prerequisites

S.address.native_rule: native request; no wide integer truncation/modulo

S.load_descriptor.native_rule: bounds and resident weight identity; no loader restart while busy

T.word_count.native_rule: BEGIN EMPTY; tail separate; whole batch capacity

compound_destination_assembly.N.norm_replay: op5 data=x plus same-group aux=gamma; independent companion/constant required.
compound_destination_assembly.N.norm_gamma: op5 aux=gamma plus same-group data=x; independent companion required.
compound_destination_assembly.N.topk_records: op9 each32bits is(score S16,ID U16); this edge may contribute one named field, not the complete record.
compound_destination_assembly.R.decay: op5 index0 low32 decay plus bits63:32 beta; upper64zero. Beta companion/constant required.
compound_destination_assembly.R.beta: op5 index0 bits63:32 beta plus low32 decay; upper64zero. Decay companion/constant required.
compound_destination_assembly.E.A_vec: Opcode declares A/B/C operand schema. Extra inputs only for operations consuming them.
compound_destination_assembly.E.B_vec: A and op-dependent C companion; opcode must actually use B.
compound_destination_assembly.E.C_vec: A/B or predicate-source companions as declared by opcode; do not invent C usage for unary op.
compound_destination_assembly.G.gate: gated=1 plus activation x. gated=0 has no mathematical gate edge.
compound_destination_assembly.G.x: gate companion/constant when gated=1; ungated function is unary.
compound_destination_assembly.M.A: A contribution can load before B but EXEC waits complete descriptor, B/tile validity and matching scale.
compound_destination_assembly.M.B_nmajor: B contribution can load before A but EXEC waits complete descriptor and A rows/tiles.

semantic_conditions.C_FAMILY: FamilySpec explicitly authorizes mathematical role/operation and this profile version.
semantic_conditions.C_UNITS: Source raw formula/Fin and destination Fout/range/overflow policy declared; no arbitrary relabel.
semantic_conditions.C_SHAPE: Valid elements, range, layout, strides, tail and companions match; padding is not data.
semantic_conditions.C_SCHEMA: Typed carrier inherits trustworthy initialization/write/lease schema and lineage; dispatch recursively.
semantic_conditions.C_FIELD: Record schema and selected field(s), signedness/extension/F are explicit; whole record is not numeric vector.
semantic_conditions.C_ID: Explicit ID_AS_INT(F=0), ID domain use, or ID_RESOLVE lookup; IDs never become logits by relabel.
semantic_conditions.C_DIAG: Product declares partial arithmetic meaning, pre-scale units and exact valid/owner lifetime.
semantic_conditions.C_FACTOR: Factor raw formula and source context establish meaningful coefficient units.
semantic_conditions.C_EXP_NUM: EXP used as unnormalized exponential value, or input to a new declared arithmetic task; not probability.
semantic_conditions.C_PROB: Probability provenance/scale retained; not relabeled as EXP or arbitrary coefficients.
semantic_conditions.C_EXP_LINE: Destination replay receives exact EXP codes whose group/max/aggregate factor it owns, or proven lossless equivalent lineage.
semantic_conditions.C_SCORE_LINE: EXP_X replays the score handle used in this group STATS; same max/version/order/valid count.
semantic_conditions.C_RECORD: TOP_RECORDS has score S16 plus ID U16; current edge provides named field(s), companions explicitly JOINed.
semantic_conditions.C_COEFF: R decay/beta/element_decay values represent the declared coefficient, UQ1.31 in 0..0x80000000; CAST alone does not compute it.
semantic_conditions.C_INJECT: R inject is an already computed algorithm quantity with units F; packing cannot create the missing arithmetic.
semantic_conditions.C_E_C: E C units/meaning match selected op: product-scale FMA or SELECT predicate, etc.
semantic_conditions.C_M_FMT: M A/B format S8/S16 selected, bank/rows/tile identities and n-major layout correct.
semantic_conditions.C_N_GAMMA: Norm gamma mathematical parameter and Q10 encoding/desired output scale explicitly bound.
semantic_conditions.C_PARAM: Unique control owner validates exact field, authorized dynamic/permanent update, identity, bounds and reserved bits.
semantic_conditions.C_INTEGRAL: Addresses/opcodes/counts/IDs are exact integers; reject invalid fields rather than modulo/unchecked clamp.
semantic_conditions.C_ACK: ACK-forward binds original write schema/version, captures payload and consumes write ACK before resource reentry.
semantic_conditions.C_DEST_OP: Selected destination opcode/mode actually consumes this named role; G.gate requires gated=1, E B/C require an operation using them.
semantic_conditions.C_COMPANION: All required independent inputs/compound fields are named and supplied by companion handles or declared ROM constants before execution.

state_guards.S_VALID: Source valid/error/sat handling and lifetime checked; no stale or already released source.
state_guards.S_READY: Destination native phase/ready/window legal; otherwise WAIT/RESUME/REENTER, not declaring whole pair illegal.
state_guards.S_OWNER: Only one native owner; task/epoch/version cannot be mixed or prematurely reused.
state_guards.S_LOADER: Consume all A/B outputs via predefined selected sinks/discards; no abort or waiting for same-S write while done is blocked.
state_guards.S_N_CONTEXT: Lock N group and phase counters; preserve context during RESUME; finish old group before unrelated BEGIN.
state_guards.S_R_CONTEXT: Respect native pending matrix. state/history/taps/element_decay need no pending; key/query/x/coeff/skip permit history-only pending.
state_guards.S_T_LIFE: BEGIN/FILL/SEALED/COMMIT/READ/RELEASE; metadata alone grants no requester access; no rewind.
state_guards.S_REENTER: Capture old result before overwrite; ordinary same-resource reentry is distinct from same-context RESUME.

mapping_guards.K_ONCHIP: No external memory. Existing S payload16384B and T payload6144B plus explicitly budgeted new on-chip support storage only.
mapping_guards.K_SLOTS: Reserve full required S words, output/event slots and companions; S insufficient => mapping gap, not semantic illegal.
mapping_guards.K_LOADER: Serial S baseline uses separate prefabricated1024B maximum transaction spool (A512+B16512), metadata extra. Not a hidden extra S port.
mapping_guards.K_T_SELF: Same T reentry reserves complete source batch in S before drain/release/new generation; at most6144B input spool, extra compute workspace separate.
mapping_guards.K_S_COPY: Overlapping S copy uses proven memmove direction or scratch; shared subword writes need RMW/lock or own whole tail word.
mapping_guards.K_M_LAYOUT: M A base and B base4-word aligned; A alloc4/8words per tile; B alloc4/8words per tile; fits actual S banks.
mapping_guards.K_ROUTE: Physical endpoints/selection/MUX/return paths must exist and satisfy frozen-base budgets; no multi-driver time-slot fiction.

gaps.G_BIND: Family/shape/profile/value and exact semantic bindings not yet instantiated.
gaps.G_SCHEMA: Input carrier schema, record field or companion selection must be resolved.
gaps.G_LINEAGE: EXP/score exact lineage or lossless-equivalence proof is missing until bound.
gaps.G_WIDE: Full S64/U64/record-wide numeric conversion path not implemented; M op5 is only a native-result subset.
gaps.G_NUMERIC: Generic numeric/pack/layout support not implemented; native E/M subsets do not close all profiles.
gaps.G_SYS: Generic export/import/storage/topology/control layer has zero new RTL/verification/physical qualification.
gaps.G_LOADER: Loader output selector, exact descriptor spool and dual-output completion support not implemented.
gaps.G_T_SELF: Complete on-chip spool/release/reopen controller not implemented.
gaps.G_ARITH: If the family requires a new coefficient/inject/score computation, it is an explicit producer arithmetic task, not transparent CAST.
gaps.G_DIAG: Diagnostic mathematical use has not been accepted by a family/profile proof.
gaps.G_PARAM: Parameterized native-command builder and data-to-parameter validator not implemented.

rejected_variants.X_BITCAST: Reject S64 as fourS32, fourS32 as eightS16, wrong low64 interpretation or record-as-vector.
rejected_variants.X_EXP_PROB: Reject EXP relabeled probability, probability relabeled EXP, changed codes using old factor or group lineage.
rejected_variants.X_ID_SCORE: Reject ID-as-logit without semantic redefinition or required score gather.
rejected_variants.X_RECORD: Reject unspecified field/schema/companion; reserved bits or signedness cannot be guessed.
rejected_variants.X_PARAM: Reject unvalidated cmd-data forwarding, unauthorized structural change, bad field bounds or reserved bits.
rejected_variants.X_STALE: Reject stale version/error payload as a valid new tensor; do not conflate an unready stage with an illegal macro pair.
rejected_variants.X_RESOURCE: Never rewrite absent on-chip capacity/RTL/route as semantic_illegal.
rejected_variants.X_REENTER: Reject direct same-T simultaneous read/FILL, implicit T rewind, M result restore fiction or premature context overwrite.

applicability.G_WIDE: Only if resolved fields/values actually require full wide conversion; a selected small field may use a proved native subset.
applicability.G_ARITH: Conditional producer dependency only. If the source already has the correct coefficient/inject meaning, no new arithmetic is implied.
applicability.S_REENTER: Only same physical instance with a new independent context; legal same-context RESUME does not require closing that context.
applicability.K_T_SELF: Only when source and destination are the same physical T. Distinct T instances have separate lease rules.
applicability.K_S_COPY: Only for actual S copy/overwrite; immutable same-range alias can use reference ownership without copying.
applicability.record_field_selection: Slot recipes select finite declared fields; they do not enumerate every field/scale/shape instance yet.
applicability.native_identity_or_subset: CAST/BITPACK operations may reduce to identity or a proved E/M subset; gaps refer to the generic system path, not denial of native primitives.

topology_requirements.bounded_feedback: Explicit initial token/version/delay; semantic adjacency self-loop is not combinational ready loop.
